$comment: Shared table for the hdf-to-xml element-name encoder. Go (xmlElementName) and TypeScript (xmlElementName) both read it, so neither language can drift. 'rewritten' is false when the key is already a legal XML Name and must be emitted unchanged.

cases.name: nist
cases.why: an ordinary tag key is untouched

cases.name: _private
cases.why: '_' is a legal Name start character

cases.name: sonarqube_hash
cases.why: real sonarqube-to-hdf key: '/' is not a Name character
a Name may not start with a digit

cases.name: my_tag
cases.why: a space is not a Name character

cases.name: a_b
cases.why: '<' would corrupt the document, not merely invalidate it

cases.name: env_prod
cases.why: ':' is a legal Name character but would invent an undeclared namespace prefix

cases.name: _-leading
cases.why: '-' is legal within a Name but not at the start

cases.name: _.leading
cases.why: '.' is legal within a Name but not at the start
an empty key has no Name to emit

cases.name: caf_
cases.why: outside the ASCII kept set, which is deliberately narrower than XML Name
ditto — no fixture key is non-ASCII, so this costs nothing on real data
